newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bankruptcies rise 8.8 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bankruptcies rise 8.8 pct in 1996.

text.p: Commercial bankruptcies in Switzerland rose 8.8 percent in 1996 to 4,156 from 1995's 3,820, Schweizerischer Verband Creditreform said.
Including non-firm bankruptcy proceedings, total bankruptcy cases rose 4.4 percent to 10,192 last year compared with 9,761 the previous year, Creditreform said in a statement.

Creditreform, a bureau which gives banks information on the creditworthiness of borrowers, also said the highest insolvency ratio last year was for the building sector, followed by the retail, industry and services sector.
The building sector had a ratio of 2.60 percent, meaning that of every 100 firms in this sector, bankruptcy proceedings were opened for more than 2.60 firms.
